## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      1 avis récent mentionne prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 8 oct. 2026 - 8 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _swright243_, 8 oct. 2026, 1/5: "I have been a member for a few years. My first complaint was that Ai had to down grade from black card to basic membership when I was having fiscal difficulties. Staff helped me make the change, but then it automatically reset to black card membership without my approval. I cannot go to the site any longer and looked up how to cancel a subscription at the portal ( was told I could) well- you cannot. So now I’m going down the rabbit hole trying to figure out how to cancel this some other way with no help other than to go in person- which I cannot."
